title: Override API HTTP 500 blast-radius census: offices 1121 and 1604 both fail (2 of 9 offices tested, two-pass, no flakes)
requirementSource: NM-1463 (Corporate PG Pricing Override Management & Context Filtering) — the override-load GET endpoint must return HTTP 200 with a valid data payload for any valid local office.
stepsToReproduce: Authenticate to cloudapps-e2e.encoreglobal.com using the automation credentials (clients/encore/.env.local).
Using an authenticated browser context, send GET https://cloudapps-e2e.encoreglobal.com/navigator/api/location/corporate-price-pg-override?localOfficeId=1121 and record the HTTP status code.
Send the same GET request a second time for office 1121 and confirm the status code is stable (no flake).
For control, repeat step 2 for offices 1105, 1137, 1169, 1606, 4104, 4107, and 8843 and confirm each returns HTTP 200.
expectedBehavior: GET /navigator/api/location/corporate-price-pg-override?localOfficeId=<X> returns HTTP 200 with a valid JSON payload for every valid local office, including 1121 and 1604.
actualBehavior: Offices 1121 and 1604 both return HTTP 500 on every call across two independent passes with no flakes. The remaining 7 of 9 tested offices return HTTP 200. The defect is not a general API regression — it is isolated to broken server-side data state on those two offices. The 1604 HTTP 500 body carries a duplicate-key exception (see BUG-CPR-OVR-002 for full body and user-facing symptoms).
